_about: The Higgsfield subscription (plan-credit) route, run by scripts/runner/higgsfield_subscription_runner.py through Higgsfield's own CLI (@higgsfield/cli). Data, not code. Nothing here is verified until `verified` says so: job_type and param names must be read from `higgsfield model list --video` / `higgsfield model get <job_type>` on a signed-in machine with an active paid plan (the CLI answers nothing without one). An operation with verified=false is never submitted. `enabled` stays false until one live job has been checked end to end.

seedance_ref._open: job_type for Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video; whether duration/resolution/aspect are accepted with a video reference; whether audio can be switched off; whether input seconds are billed as on the API; the credit quote for 4 s at 720p
